evidence: Plaut. Aul. 73: quasi claudus sūtor domī sedet tōtōs diēs
Nep. Ages. 8.1: claudus alterō pede (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: pervigilat noctēs tōtās, tum autem interdius quasi claudus sūtor domī sedet tōtōs diēs
phrases.english: he lies awake all night long, and then by day he sits at home all day like a lame cobbler

phrases.latin: nihil est: tamquam sī claudus sim, cum fūstīst ambulandum
phrases.english: it’s no good: I have to walk with a stick, as if I were lame
